name: Pluto Altus Arolandia
original_name: プルート＝アルタス＝アロランディア
source:
Affiliation: Temple
Hobby: Playing Musical Instruments
Special Skill: Drawing Portraits
Likes: Pure Things
Dislikes: Impure Things

The ruler of Arolandia, the head priest of the temple and a 'Star Reader'.
He takes his duties seriously, but sometimes he disguises himself to go out into the city, he longs for to live the life of a normal citizen.
A stable person who loves cleanliness.
